rationale.conceptual: The method (B3LYP/6-31G(d,p) DFT with thermodynamic corrections and Mulliken population analysis) is an established but non-trivial protocol. It requires careful implementation of the paper's specific radical species, adsorption pathways, and conditions (750°C, 1 atm), but it does not involve a novel algorithm or deep domain theory beyond standard quantum chemistry.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has ~4-6 stages: building 39+ molecular geometries, running geometry optimizations and frequency calculations, extracting thermodynamic quantities, computing enthalpy changes, and performing Mulliken population analysis. This involves multiple interdependent steps and many individual DFT jobs, but can be managed with a single computational chemistry package and scripting.
